table_raw=ida_bytes.get_bytes(callable_table,544)
assert table_raw is not None and len(table_raw)==544
callable_records=[dict(index=i,tag=tag,service=svc,target=target) for i,(tag,svc,target) in enumerate(struct.iter_unpack('<IIQ',table_raw))]
ntdll_file=open(r'C:\Windows\System32\ntdll.dll','rb').read()
def u16(o):return struct.unpack_from('<H',ntdll_file,o)[0]
def u32(o):return struct.unpack_from('<I',ntdll_file,o)[0]
pe=u32(0x3c);opt=pe+24
sections=[struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIIIHHI',ntdll_file,opt+u16(pe+20)+40*i) for i in range(u16(pe+6))]
def offset(rva):
 if rva<u32(opt+60):return rva
 for row in sections:
  if row[2]<=rva<row[2]+max(row[1],row[3]):return row[4]+rva-row[2]
 raise ValueError(rva)
def name_hash(name):
 h=0x811c9dc5
 for byte in name.encode('ascii'):h=((h^(byte|0x20))*0x1000193)&0xffffffff
 return h
exp=offset(u32(opt+112));exports={}
for i in range(u32(exp+24)):
 p=offset(u32(offset(u32(exp+32))+4*i))
 name=ntdll_file[p:ntdll_file.index(b'\0',p)].decode('ascii')
 rva=u32(offset(u32(exp+28))+4*u16(offset(u32(exp+36))+2*i))
 exports.setdefault(name_hash(name),[]).append((name,rva,offset(rva)))
captured_service_proof=[]
for row in callable_records:
 matches=exports.get(row['tag'],[])
 assert len(matches)==1
 name,rva,off=matches[0]
 ea=0x2c0e8c80000+rva-0x1000
 capture=ida_bytes.get_bytes(ea,24);filebytes=ntdll_file[off:off+24]
 svc=struct.unpack_from('<I',capture,4)[0] if capture and capture[:4]==bytes.fromhex('4c8bd1b8') else None
 p=dict(index=row['index'],tag=row['tag'],name=name,export_rva=rva,captured_ea=ea,captured_hex=capture.hex(),current_file_hex=filebytes.hex(),captured_service=svc,table_service=row['service'],service_matches=svc==row['service'],file_prefix_matches=capture==filebytes)
 captured_service_proof.append(p)
 print(row['index'],name,hex(ea),hex(svc) if svc is not None else 'patched',p['service_matches'],p['file_prefix_matches'])

print('all',len(captured_service_proof),'service_matches',sum(p['service_matches'] for p in captured_service_proof))
for k in range(12):
 ea=0x2c0e8c80000+k*0x16a09c+0x161410-0x1000
 print('NtOpenFile_copy',k,hex(ea),ida_bytes.get_bytes(ea,12).hex())

ordinary_graph_source:
def native_graph(a,b,limit=20000):
 insns={};edges={};outside=[];bad=[];indirect=[];pending=[a]
 while pending:
  ea=pending.pop()
  if ea in insns:continue
  if not a<=ea<b:outside.append(ea);continue
  ii=ida_ua.insn_t()
  if not ida_ua.decode_insn(ii,ea) or ea+ii.size>b:bad.append(ea);continue
  insns[ea]=ii;m=ii.get_canon_mnem().lower();nxt=ea+ii.size
  if m in ('ret','retn','retf','iret','int3','ud2'):ts=[]
  elif m=='jmp':
   if ii.ops[0].type==ida_ua.o_near:ts=[ii.ops[0].addr]
   else:
    si=ida_nalt.get_switch_info(ea); cases=ida_xref.calc_switch_cases(ea,si) if si else None
    if cases:ts=list(cases.targets)
    else:indirect.append(ea);ts=[]
  elif m.startswith('j') or m.startswith('loop'):ts=[ii.ops[0].addr,nxt]
  else:ts=[nxt]
  edges[ea]=ts;pending.extend(ts)
  if len(insns)>limit:raise RuntimeError('graph limit')
 return insns,edges,outside,bad,indirect
def flag_flow_graph(a,b):
 ns,ed,out,bad,ind=native_graph(a,b)
 return {},ns,ed,out,bad,len(ns),ind
